title: Sur les réflexions d'un rayon de lumière à l'intérieur d'une veine liquide parabolique
venue: Comptes rendus hebdomadaires des séances de l'Académie des sciences
significance: First published report of light guided by total internal reflection along a curved water jet; experiment performed in Geneva in 1841.

era: E3 1980-1989 long-wavelength systems, InP, silica PLC, EDFA
title: Low-noise erbium-doped fibre amplifier operating at 1.54μm
significance: Southampton erbium-doped fibre amplifier: up to 28 dB gain in 3 m of fibre near 1.536 um; one of two 1987 founding EDFA reports.

era: E4 1990-1999 WDM, AWG, QPM, photonic crystals, microcavities
title: All-silica single-mode optical fiber with photonic crystal cladding
dri: J. C. Knight; P. St. J. Russell
significance: First photonic crystal (holey) fiber: silica core in a hexagonal air-hole cladding, guiding single-mode by index guiding; REF case study credits first light-guiding microstructured fibre.

era: E4 1990-1999 WDM, AWG, QPM, photonic crystals, microcavities
title: Microring resonator channel dropping filters
dri: B. E. Little; H. A. Haus
dri_source: fresh-context audit A 2026-11-11 (byline order plus row evidence; no fetched page names the lead)
significance: Coupled-mode-in-time theory of microring add-drop filters; multi-ring designs improve passband shape and rejection.

era: E5 2000-2009 silicon photonics, frequency combs, coherent DSP
title: A high-speed silicon optical modulator based on a metal–oxide–semiconductor capacitor
significance: First silicon modulator with bandwidth above 1 GHz (MOS-capacitor phase shifter), versus about 20 MHz previously.

dri: T. J. Kippenberg; M. L. Gorodetsky
